user.title: Create a Bluetooth Mesh network
user.description: This creates a new, private Bluetooth Mesh network with its own random keys. You will then add your lamps from this integration's page.

user.title: Add a lamp
user.description: Only lamps that were reset are listed (switch the lamp on and off 5 times, it then blinks). A lamp already paired with another app or network will not appear. A lamp that is switched off disappears from the list after 30 seconds: tick "Refresh the list" and submit to update it.

none_found.title: No lamp found
none_found.description: No reset lamp nearby. Switch the lamp on and off 5 times until it blinks, then submit to try again.

reconfigure.title: Re-pair the lamp
reconfigure.description: Use this if "{name}" was reset (switched on and off 5 times, it blinks): it then no longer answers Home Assistant. It will be paired again, keeping its name, entity and automations.

progress.provision: Pairing and configuring the lamp. This takes about 20 seconds.

abort.entry_not_loaded: The network is not running. Enable it, then try again.
abort.provisioning_failed: The lamp could not be added: {error}

error.not_reset: This lamp is not waiting to be paired. Switch it on and off 5 times until it blinks, then try again.

command_failed.message: The lamp did not execute the command: {error}
